You see Cillia.

    Location

    On Main Street in Thais, exhibition entrance in The Games Hall.

    Notes

    She works as a ticket seller for the Thais Exhibition and therefore only appears on Sundays.
    The ticket is for free during the Kingsday Mini World Change, otherwise its price is 50 gold.

    She will trade you only by Saying the Word "Replica"
